CustomField.formula: TEXT(DATEVALUE(Follow_Up_Date_Time__c + (5.5/24))) & " " & TEXT( IF( MOD(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Follow_Up_Date_Time__c + (5.5/24))),12)=0, 12, MOD(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Follow_Up_Date_Time__c + (5.5/24))),12) ) ) & ":" & RIGHT( "00" & TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(Follow_Up_Date_Time__c + (5.5/24)))), 2 ) & " " & IF( HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Follow_Up_Date_Time__c + (5.5/24))) < 12, "AM", "PM" )
CustomField.label: Follow-Up Date/Time
